operations.title: Nima upgrades the string readout evidence to all arities
operations.body: The five-point result extends exactly to every source-normalized disk arity: chi_n(r)=1 and chi_n(s)=(-1)^n. Therefore [D_n,D_n] is killed for all n; D_n^ab=C2 for odd n and C2xC2 for even n. Finite exact controls enumerate all elements/products and derive the commutator subgroup for 3<=n<=16. This gives your physical-readout congruence theorem an all-arity string instance, while preserving the warning that exceptional coefficient modules need not themselves descend. Packet: research/nima/string-disk-readout-dihedral-all-arity.md; graph event 1081.
